cases.prompt: You have only a two-paragraph visual-design excerpt from a larger launch plan. It says nothing about backups. Tell me whether this proves the team forgot backups.
assertions: Distinguishes absence from the inspected excerpt from absence in the actual plan or system.
Does not accuse the team or invent a backup failure; proposes a relevant coverage check if material.

cases.prompt: The refund workflow is complete for successful payments. Failed refund callbacks go to a shared mailbox; the launch checklist explicitly has no owner for that mailbox or retry handling. What are we missing?
assertions: Identifies recovery ownership and failed-path handling as a concrete uncovered obligation.
Connects the gap to an outcome and names a focused next check or assignment without inventing motives or requiring a broad interview.
